name: General LLM pool (llama-swap + vLLM, llm-gpu.pow)
purpose: the general model pool on GPU1: llama-swap on :9292 (http://llm-gpu.pow via Traefik on .100, PowStation config/traefik/dynamic/llm-gpu.yml) starts vLLM per model on first request and unloads it after 10 idle minutes; models general (Qwen/Qwen3-14B-AWQ, 32k, tools, thinking; general-nothink = thinking off), vision (Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ, 16k), embed (BAAI/bge-m3); embed may sit beside general or vision, never general with vision; OpenAI API (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/models); phase 4: the router's general/vision/embed
installedBy: hosts/gpu-195/install.sh (rootless podman quadlet, user powos, linger on)
autosleep: llama-swap ttl 600 s per model (the proxy stays up, ~30 MB RAM, no VRAM)
vramBudget: 19.2g (general or vision 0.70 + embed 0.10 of 24 GiB; stt-batch holds the other 2.4)
vramNote: GPU1 only, shared with stt-batch; GPU0 is the realtime voice path's (docs/GPU-SERVERS-PLAN.md)
